profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Greetings! 👋 With 12+ years as a Senior Java Backend Engineer, I specialize in designing and delivering scalable microservices, event-driven platforms, and cloud-native solutions across retail, finance, and compliance domains. My work has powered enterprise systems handling 20K+ daily transactions, cut operational incidents by 25%, and reduced system costs by 65% through architecture modernization.

I thrive at the intersection of software architecture and complex problem solving — from re-engineering monoliths into microservices, to deploying high-scale applications on AWS (EKS, Lambda, EC2), to enforcing test automation and code quality standards with JUnit, Mockito, SonarQube, and Jacoco. I’m equally passionate about mentoring teams, leading design/code reviews, and driving engineering excellence.

At Walmart, I designed APIs and workflows that reduced supply chain costs by 20%, built validation frameworks that saved 150+ person-days, and boosted customer satisfaction by 15%. At CBRE, I contributed to cloud-native software architecture for compliance platforms, automated summarization reporting pipelines that improved decision-making by 25%, and led adoption of reusable LLM integration frameworks that cut AI integration effort by 40%. Earlier at HSBC, Infosys, and Lumium, I led teams through modernization initiatives, delivered reusable enterprise components, and built portals that accelerated client delivery cycles by weeks.

Most recently, I have Spearheaded GenAI/Copilot adoption in engineering workflows — automating test case generation, documentation, and data extraction. This reduced onboarding time by 60%, saved 16 hours per sprint, and accelerated release cycles by 25%.

I am always eager to solve hard problems, scale complex systems, and create measurable business impact. If you’re looking for someone who can combine deep Java/Spring expertise, software architecture leadership, and forward-looking GenAI-driven productivity, let’s connect.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed APIs and microservices to support 20,000+ daily returns, enabling agent-led processing and boosting customer satisfaction by 15%.
• Implemented event-driven workflows to validate vendor agreements and generate return labels, reducing supply chain costs by 20%.
• Built Spring Boot + Kafka validation framework with JSON comparators to automate regression checks, cutting QA effort by 150 person-days across returns pipelines.
• Improved legacy code quality and stability by raising test coverage 45%, identifying implementation gaps, and reducing latency by 15% and operational incidents by 10%.
• Deployed services using Docker + Kubernetes pipelines with feature-flag–based rollouts, ensuring reliable and controlled feature releases.
• GenAI/Copilot Initiatives: Automated data extraction, documentation, and test generation, saving 16 hours per sprint, shortening onboarding from 2 weeks to 5 days, and cutting release cycles by 25%.
• Mentored junior developers and led code/design reviews, elevating team-wide delivery velocity and adherence to engineering best practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and deployed Java microservices and REST APIs on AWS (EKS, Lambda, EC2), powering compliance platforms adopted by 8 teams with 5 more onboarding quarterly.
• Delivered compliance tracking enhancements with Spring boot and SQL, improving regulatory alignment by 15% across enterprise workflows.
• Automated KPI reporting pipelines with Java + SQL, improving executive decision-making by 25% through faster insights.
• Developed a standardized LLM integration framework in Java, creating reusable AI components that reduced integration effort by 40% and accelerated adoption across multiple business teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed data pipelines using Java microservices to identify potential sales opportunities.
•	Worked with senior management to add features to existing applications using Python and SQL, to provide relevant compliance data, resulting in 15% improvement in tracking compliance issues and aligning business decisions
•	Created reports and dashboards on ‘Product Roadmap Alignment’, to highlight any gaps in product roadmaps amongst various teams , increasing operation efficiency by 25%.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed Inventory management workflow application using Spring boot microservices and Rest API.
• Demonstrated complex problem solving by integrating data pipelines with reporting dashboards, giving leadership real-time visibility and reducing turnaround from weeks to days.

positions.title: Student Ambassador, MS ITM Student Leadership Council

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Team Lead
positions.description:
• Led a 10+ member engineering team, mentoring 5 juniors, conducting code reviews, and driving sprint planning and architectural decisions.
• Partnered with architects for design reviews and led modernization of a legacy WebSphere monolith into microservices architecture, reducing operating costs by 65% and incidents by 25%.
• Designed and deployed Spring Boot REST APIs, improving modularity and automation for business-critical workflows.
• Implemented CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, cutting release cycle times by 65% and improving deployment reliability.
• Optimized backend services for peak financial transaction loads, ensuring high availability, scalability, and compliance with enterprise banking standards.

positions.title: Senior System Engineer
positions.description:
• Acted as engineering lead, clarifying requirements with product/business stakeholders and aligning delivery with technical feasibility.
• Championed adoption of Spring MVC to modernize legacy applications, improving maintainability and scalability.
• Negotiated project scope expansion, leading to a $6 million project, contributing to 10% of account contribution to the company.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Built a Spring MVC sales portal enabling client design iterations, reducing sales closure time by 75% and adopted by 15 clients
• Collaborated with UI/UX and QA teams to deliver a customer-focused application, reducing bug leakage by 30% and improving adoption rates.
